description: Verify the off-chain fee quote against the on-chain DPXSettlementRouter contract before executing. Use this as a trust check in autonomous agent flows — confirms the rate you were quoted is what the smart contract will actually charge. Returns feesMatch (true/false), the off-chain vs on-chain fee comparison, and a recommendation. If feesMatch is false, do not proceed. Call after settlement.quote and before settlement.execute.
name: fees.verify
